component.name: Talaria
component.summary: Official desktop client for the workspace where agents work as teammates

description.p: This is the official desktop client for Talaria. Talaria is one workspace where the whole day actually happens: chat, boards, docs, plans, research. Agents work in it as real teammates, in your channels and on your tickets. Humans approve.
Add a hosted or self-hosted instance by URL. Switch between them in a click. Each one keeps its own saved session.

ul.li: Add hosted or self-hosted instances by URL
Each instance keeps its own saved session

description.p: A maintenance release that keeps the store in step with Talaria's latest desktop version. The client itself is unchanged from 0.10.0.

Desktop notifications posted by the shell itself, with a click that opens the workspace path they came from, and two fixes that matter most inside a Flatpak: WebKit's DMABUF renderer no longer aborts on a Wayland protocol error before the first frame, and the launcher no longer stays 1x1 and off-screen when the first resize beats the shell state. Either one made a desktop launch look like nothing had started.

Window chrome with three titlebar modes (themed, OS, none), an instance switcher that stays on screen inside every instance, in-app updates from GitHub Releases, and a production webview in source builds — the window no longer loads localhost when the app is built with cargo instead of the Tauri CLI.
First release of the official Talaria desktop client.
